title: style-review: calibrate analyzer-redundant rules to info; keep correctness bugs out of style scope
summary: The al-style-review skill recalibrates analyzer-redundant rules to info severity and clarifies domain boundaries to keep correctness issues out of the style scope, reducing false-positive findings in code review.
key_points: Mechanical conventions already enforced by CodeCop (like this keyword, tooltip requirements, label scope) are downgraded to info severity instead of minor
Correctness, logic, and data-integrity defects are redirected from the style domain to appropriate channels like al-code-review's agent channel
Severity calibration reserves minor for style issues with concrete downstream impact that analyzers don't catch (translation loss, option caption mismatches, misleading invocations)
Domain boundaries clarified with concrete counter-examples and a reliable test: if no style best practice can be cited, it's likely not a style finding
Changes are guidance-only edits to the skill; no schema or engine changes
